lead.headline: Barkley inactive in London; Tate 'definitely trending' toward playing, with one check at 09:30
lead.deck: Written before the inactive lists. Your lineup is the projection lineup, Lawrence and Tuten are active and playing, and Golden is ready if Tate's name is on the list.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Saquon Barkley is on Philadelphia's inactive list in London, he did not practise all week, and nobody has said when he returns. You are 0–4 and last in a waiver order that never resets. Carnell Tate is still officially questionable with a back, and this edition is written two hours before the list that settles it. The reporting, though, improved overnight: ESPN's Jeremy Fowler has Tate 'definitely trending' toward playing against Houston, the defence that allows receivers the most. Trevor Lawrence and Bhayshul Tuten were not on Jacksonville's inactive list and kicked off at 07:30; the Eagles they face are without Barkley, DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown. You lead 28–1 on George Pickens's 13-target Thursday, and ESPN has it 133.4 to 122.3, 56%. Around your roster: Caleb Williams is not expected to play, so Tyson Bagent throws to Colston Loveland again; Alvin Kamara is expected to play; a rival dropped Zach Charbonnet, who is still on the PUP list after January's ACL tear; and Marvin Harrison Jr., free in this league, is believed to be headed to Houston. Your lineup is the projection lineup. At 09:30, look for one name: if Tate is inactive, Golden takes his slot.

rows.name: Sean Tucker
rows.reason: Carried from Friday's research; pass 2 this morning kept him on the list and Sunday's searches found nothing new. 5 carries for 18 behind Bucky Irving's 21 for 165; RotoWire calls him 'firmly entrenched' as the third back. Not on the published wire.

rows.name: Kenny Gainwell
rows.reason: Carried from Friday's research; pass 2 this morning kept him on the list and Sunday's searches found nothing new. 4 carries and 4 targets for 5.8 as the passing-down back (archive). On waivers until 01:00 on Wednesday, and you are last in the order.

rows.name: Kendre Miller
rows.reason: Researched again this morning: Rapoport reports Alvin Kamara is expected to play, so Miller stays the second back; if Kamara sat, Miller and CJ Donaldson would share (ESPN's Katherine Terrell, 9 Oct). 6 carries for 9 in Week 4. You hold Kamara from the same backfield. Not on the published wire.
rows.falsifiedIf: Kamara is inactive today and Miller takes 15 or more touches.

rows.name: KaVontae Turpin
rows.reason: Carried from Friday's research; pass 2 this morning kept him on the list and Sunday's searches found nothing new. 4 targets for 2.2, a season high attributed to Lamb leaving (RotoWire, 10 Oct). Lamb's quad is a bruise. Not on the published wire.

rows.name: Ryan Flournoy
rows.reason: Carried from Friday's research; pass 2 this morning kept him on the list and Sunday's searches found nothing new. 3 catches for 90 on 4 targets, 12.0 (archive). That is efficiency on four targets, the fluke signature, and Lamb is expected back.
rows.falsifiedIf: Seven or more targets at Green Bay in Week 6.

rows.name: Tre' Harris
rows.reason: New on pass 2 and researched this morning: Schefter reports Ladd McConkey is not expected to play after aggravating his foot, with no on-field work since; Quentin Johnston and Brenen Thompson are out. RotoWire expects Harris to be the Chargers' top target against Denver. Touches 7 and 5 for 13.6 and 9.0. 9.8 and free, so no priority is at stake; a sixth receiver here, and off in Week 7.
rows.falsifiedIf: McConkey plays in Week 6, or Harris draws fewer than six targets today with him out.

cannotSee.label: The inactive lists
cannotSee.body: This brief was written at about 07:30 Mexico City. London's lists were read; the lists for the 11:00 games come out at 09:30. Tate's call is provisional until then, and the one card is yours to fire from that list.

cannotSee.label: London
cannotSee.body: Lawrence and Tuten are active by their absence from the inactive list; no page names them as active. The game began after the snapshot, so no score is shown and none was read.

cannotSee.label: Tate's back
cannotSee.body: Fowler's 'definitely trending' is an insider's report. Saleh has still not been quoted first-hand: 'good to go' and 'fine' are a reporter's posts from Friday.

cannotSee.label: Barkley's return
cannotSee.body: Nobody has given a date. 'Week-to-week' is from 5 Oct, and nothing addresses Week 6 against Carolina.

cannotSee.label: Harrison's trade
cannotSee.body: Fowler reports a belief that he is going to Houston; a second research pass, reading ESPN items from 9 Oct, found Arizona 'not shopping him'. The newer report is used. Nothing is completed, and ESPN's own story could not be opened.

cannotSee.label: Who starts at quarterback
cannotSee.body: Lawrence and Hurts are playing. Bagent is confirmed by Garafolo's Sunday report on Williams. Daniel Jones, Geno Smith, Cam Ward, Jordan Love and Malik Willis are confirmed only by being off the injury report; nothing contradicts any of them.

cannotSee.label: Miami's backfield
cannotSee.body: Nothing dated Sunday. Hafley's 'will play' on Wright and Saturday's elevation could not be re-opened and are carried.

cannotSee.label: Rice and Tyreek Hill
cannotSee.body: Nothing newer than 7 Oct on Rice, and two reports of his hamstring disagree; the later and milder one is used. Nothing newer than 5 Oct on Hill.

cannotSee.label: Jacobs
cannotSee.body: The newest item found on his exempt-list status is from 13 Sep. Saturday's brief had an 8 Oct item; today's pass could not find it again.

cannotSee.label: Charbonnet
cannotSee.body: No one has given a target week. Whether a rival ahead of you claims him on Wednesday is invisible.

cannotSee.label: Weather
cannotSee.body: Pittsburgh's National Weather Service forecast (00:36 EDT) is the wettest and the newest; other sites are milder. East Rutherford's rain figure is from a Saturday article. One site lists Chicago at Green Bay at 16:25 ET; ESPN's file has 13:00 ET.

cannotSee.label: Matchup grades
cannotSee.body: FootballDB's PPR table, Weeks 1 to 4, read by a research pass through a page-summarising tool; Thursday's game is not in it and ties are common. No ranked list of defences opened today, so the defence tile carries Saturday's CBS consensus.

cannotSee.label: Quotes
cannotSee.body: Every page was read through a summarising tool by a research pass, so quotations are close but may not be exact. Search returns several seasons at once; items from earlier seasons on Lamb, Kittle, Watson and Kamara were found and discarded.

cannotSee.label: The wire screen
cannotSee.body: It reads this week's live archive, which holds only Thursday night's game, so it is dominated by Buccaneers and Cowboys. Pass 2, with Dowdle and McConkey added to the confirmed-out list, brought in one newcomer, Tre' Harris, and dropped Will Shipley. Sean Tucker, KaVontae Turpin and Kendre Miller are not on the published wire.

cannotSee.label: Rival claims
cannotSee.body: ESPN shows only your own. You are last in the order, so any claim of yours loses to any rival's; free agents cost nothing. Worthy clears at 01:00 on Monday; Charbonnet, Gainwell, Ferguson and Otton at 01:00 on Wednesday.

cannotSee.label: The trade market
cannotSee.body: No trade this run. Barkley and Rice have no timetables, so nothing can be priced.
